metric: Sum of official npm daily range counts across the measured ruvnet maintainer cohort over the stated 365 day window. Download events include CI, reinstalls and platform packages; not unique users or lifetime downloads.
coverage: Observed lower bound: 399 measured packages out of 401 inventoried packages. Unavailable packages are excluded, never counted as zero.

reporting.caveat: All zero cohort days may be reporting gaps. Trailing all zero days do not extend the reported through date. No missing events are estimated.

scope_change: The previous badge counted six selected packages. This snapshot uses the full measured maintainer cohort; the increase is a scope correction and refresh, not organic growth against the old total.
